schema.title: Response Post Call Api V1 Webhooks Elevenlabs Post Call Post

Addon.title: Addon
Addon.description: A priced add-on. `unit="video"` means one more video at this price.

BestValue.title: BestValue
BestValue.description: A thread's place in the best-value ranking, with the reasons that earned it.

BrandOnboarding.title: BrandOnboarding
BrandOnboarding.description: Onboarding as a brand ("I sell products"): the brand and the product it promotes.

BriefCreatorPreview.title: BriefCreatorPreview
BriefCreatorPreview.description: One creator of a brief: the package it is compared against and how to reach them.

BriefPatch.title: BriefPatch
BriefPatch.description:
Changes to a brief. Only the fields the client sent are applied; an explicit `null`
clears a field (`flexibility: null` empties the list).

BriefSummary.title: BriefSummary
BriefSummary.description: The brief behind a batch. `budget_ceiling_cents` is brand-only (the board is too).

CheckCounterRequest.title: CheckCounterRequest
CheckCounterRequest.description: The agent asks whether the creator's price fits. Agents speak dollars (Ruling 9).

CreateBriefRequest.title: CreateBriefRequest
CreateBriefRequest.description: The creators a new brief is for, in the order the brand picked them.

CreatorCard.title: CreatorCard
CreatorCard.description:
A creator with their published packages, cheapest first.

`engagement_rate` is in percentage points (5.8 means 5.8%).

CreatorChip.title: CreatorChip
CreatorChip.description: Who a thread is with; never their contact details.

CreatorOnboarding.title: CreatorOnboarding
CreatorOnboarding.description: Onboarding as a creator ("I create content"): the public creator profile.

CreatorRef.title: CreatorRef
CreatorRef.description: A creator on screen, so "select Maya" can be resolved to an id.

DealBrief.title: DealBrief
DealBrief.description: A brief as the brand sees it. `missing` and `violations` are computed on every read.

DraftFromSpeechRequest.title: DraftFromSpeechRequest
DraftFromSpeechRequest.description: What the creator just said about a package, and the draft it is to be folded into.

DraftResult.title: DraftResult
DraftResult.description:
The open draft after the latest dictation, what it still needs, and what it breaks.

`missing` lists the required fields with no value yet, in the order the editor asks
for them. `violations` are the publishing rules already broken by the values present.

EmailPreview.title: EmailPreview
EmailPreview.description: The outreach email as drafted; `delivered` is False for a test address, None until sent.

Extra.title: Extra
Extra.description: A priced extra that is not a deliverable (raw footage, a thumbnail pack).

FloorRequest.title: FloorRequest
FloorRequest.description: The lowest price (cents) the creator will accept for a package; never shown to brands.

LaunchExclusion.title: LaunchExclusion
LaunchExclusion.description: A creator the launch left out, and why.

LaunchRequest.title: LaunchRequest
LaunchRequest.description:
How to launch: the channel per creator (a missing creator gets the default for their
package and contact details) and what to do with creators who never reply.

LogOfferRequest.title: LogOfferRequest
LogOfferRequest.description: The agent logs what was just said on the call, by either side.

MeResponse.title: MeResponse
MeResponse.description: The signed-in user; `role` is null until onboarding.

MyPackage.title: MyPackage
MyPackage.description:
A package card plus what only its creator sees or edits: status, private floor and
the terms a card leaves out (`included`, `freebies`, `extras`, `slots_per_month`).

NegotiationTerms.title: NegotiationTerms
NegotiationTerms.description: Terms as stated by one side in one message or call; every deal field is optional.

OpenThreadArgs.title: OpenThreadArgs
OpenThreadArgs.description: Whose thread to open on the board.

PackageDelta.title: PackageDelta
PackageDelta.description:
How the brief's ask (and the creator's latest terms) differ from the listed package.

`listed_price_cents` is the listed price for the ask's video count, not the base price.

PackageDraft.title: PackageDraft
PackageDraft.description: `PackageTerms` with every field optional, as filled in by speech and clicks.

PackageSummary.title: PackageSummary
PackageSummary.description: A published package as shown on a creator card. `one_liner` is its card text.

RuleViolation.title: RuleViolation
RuleViolation.description: A package rule that fails, reported against the field the creator must change.

SavedPackage.title: SavedPackage
SavedPackage.description:
A package after an edit that may touch the search index. `warnings` lists side
effects that did not complete; the package itself was saved.

ScribeToken.title: ScribeToken
ScribeToken.description: A single-use ElevenLabs realtime Scribe token for the browser; `expires_at` is ISO 8601.

SearchFilters.title: SearchFilters

SearchRequest.title: SearchRequest
SearchRequest.description:
`query` is free text that ranks the filtered creators by meaning; without it the
most-followed creators come first.

SearchResponse.title: SearchResponse
SearchResponse.description: The request as applied (blank query and region normalised) and the matches in rank order.

SelectArgs.title: SelectArgs
SelectArgs.description: Which creators to select: those named (`creator_ids`) or the first `top_n` shown.

ThreadCard.title: ThreadCard
ThreadCard.description: One creator's negotiation on the board.

TranscriptTurn.title: TranscriptTurn
TranscriptTurn.description: One spoken turn of a call: who spoke, what they said, and seconds from the start.

VoiceContext.title: VoiceContext
VoiceContext.description: What the screen shows: the creators in view and the package draft being dictated.

VoiceIntent.title: VoiceIntent
VoiceIntent.description:
What the screen should do. Only the field for `kind` is set; `unclear` carries
`suggestions` of what to say instead.

VoiceSessionResponse.title: VoiceSessionResponse
VoiceSessionResponse.description: What the browser needs to start a conversation with the brief agent.
